s: Dine zemirot beyom hashshabbat ubo h' seipim: beshabbat tzarik lehaqdim labo lebet hakkeneset yoter mibbeyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqk"t. Umikkol maqom, nohagim leacher yoter mibbechol, mishshum hashshena shehi oneg shabbat. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher meod shello laabor zeman qeriat shema utepilla. Abal bime hachorep shehallelot arukkim — yekolim lehaqdim kemo bechol:

Venohagim leharbot bizmirot shel shabbat, dehaynu shemmosipim bipsuqe dezimra: "lamnatztzeach hashshamayim ku'", veomerim "nishmat" achar shirat hayyam, umesayyemin bo "yishtabbach". Veachar kak matchilin "yotzer or", ve"hakkol yoduka", ve"el adon", ve"lael asher shabat". Ubekol maqom umaqom lepi minhago. Umikkol maqom, en kol zeh choba ella reshut, veim ratza eno omer kelal. Millebad "lael asher shabat", sheap im shakach leomro betok hattepilla — nakon leomro achar hattepilla, hoil vehu medabber beshebach hashshabbat. Umikkol maqom, im nizkar betok hattepilla, apillu qodem shessiyyem birkat "yotzer" — lo yachazor lerosh habberaka bishbilo, hoil veeno ella minhag beolma. (Vehu haddin shello yomar oto lebaddo bemaqom shennizkar, kevan sheeno shayyak sham):

Veyesh lehaarik ulehanim beniggun hazzemirot shel shabbat bishbil kebod hayyom. Veen limchot bishliach tzibbur shemmaarik bahem beniggun, ap al pi shehammocheh mitkavven mishshum bittul tora. Umikkol maqom, lo yaarik yoter midday, kede sheyyoklu qodem chatzot hayyom, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rp"ch:
Vekol zeh beniggun sheyyesh bo neima keen sheosin bipsuqe dezimra, abal lo kemo hamshorerim hammaarikim beshir umapridim teba mechabertah, ukebar hipligu haqqadmonim bignutam, (ayyen simman n"g):
Keshemmaggia be"nishmat" le"uleka anachnu modim" — lo yishcheh sham kemo be"modim", sheen lishchot ella bimqomot sheameru chakamim, kemo shennitbaer besimman qy"g:
